body.text: Is the battery switch ON and is the 15 A start fuse F2 good? TEST OPTIONS: Look at the switch. Pull F2 and check it with the multimeter. REASON FOR QUESTION: A switch left OFF or a blown fuse stops all cranking current. KNOWN INFO: The engine does not crank. POSSIBLE PROBLEMS: Battery switch off. Start fuse F2 blown. Battery discharged. Starter relay K1 failed. If NO: Turn the battery switch ON or replace fuse F2, then try to start. Does the engine crank now?
